policy.description: Early opening reversal restricted to SEC item 2.02 earnings catalysts.

scanner.buffer_target: Up to 80 candidates per date before IBKR preflight; minimum 10.
scanner.dilution_screen: Item 3.02 plus strong primary-document financing and common-stock issuance phrases.
scanner.eligibility: Direct material issuer 8-K accepted before the replay boundary, mapped to NYSE/Nasdaq; IBKR COMMON stockType required before freeze.
scanner.provider: Robinhood earnings calendar + SEC EDGAR daily index, submissions metadata, and issuer filings
scanner.ranking: Verified Item 2.02 earnings by normalized absolute EPS surprise, then material SEC item priority, acceptance time, and symbol.
scanner.selection_policy: All dates frozen before source collection; no target-session market prices were requested.
scanner.universe_scope: Verified earnings symbols from the prior two sessions and target date, cross-checked against mapped NYSE/Nasdaq 8-K filings accepted by 09:30 ET.
